sources.finding: Administration generateLink supports custom email delivery; signup needs an email and password.
Provider minimum and character policy remain authoritative. Password-change reauthentication/current-password settings require live journey qualification.
Provider session lifetime and JWT lifetime are distinct; local fixture behavior is not proof that all existing provider access JWTs are immediately invalidated.
Signout scope controls affected refresh sessions; access-token expiry must be considered separately.

decision: Reuse existing AccountEmailAdapter, browser identity and provider SDK; do not add another identity store or authentication system. Keep registration/provider configuration unchanged in this lane.
